{{Top|leg}}
'''Imperial Detention Block Guards''' were technically members of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and had the responsibility of making sure that none of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] political prisoners escaped from various Imperial prison facilities. These guards, who were equipped with [[Baton/Legends|batons]], were trained to pacify rioting prisoners, but they were also proficient combatants with their [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]. In addition, they also received rudimentary training in prisoner psychology from [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].

Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Imperial Detention Block Guards defended a secret prison facility that existed on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]] was being held.
